newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA'S SINOPEC MAOMING UNIT SETS US$30 MLN LOAN.
newsitem.headline: CHINA'S SINOPEC MAOMING UNIT SETS US$30 MLN LOAN.

text.p: The following syndicated loan issue was announced by the arrangers.
BORROWER SINO SHINE FAR EAST LIMITED
AMOUNT UP TO US$30 MLN TYPE TERM LOAN
MARGIN 6ML+110BP MATURITY 5 YRS AVGE LIFE --
PUTS NONE CALLS NONE LAUNCHED WK 04.AUG
DRAWDOWN -- AVAIL 1 MTH HOME CTRY CHINA
REPAYMENT 8 SEMI-ANNUAL INSTALMENTS AFTER 18 MTHS GRACE
ARRANGERS AND UNDERWRITERS
BANK BRUSSELS LAMBERT'S HONG KONG BRANCH, COMMERZ (EAST ASIA)
AND SUMITOMO BANK (AGENT)
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
COMMITMENT FEE 37.5BP
LEAD MANAGERS US$5 MLN+ 40BP
MANAGERS US$2-4 MLN 35BP
NOTES THE BORROWER IS A WHOLLY OWNED SUBSIDIARY OF SINOPEC
MAOMING PETROCHEMICAL CO (SINOPEC MAOMING).
A LETTER OF SUPPORT FROM CHINA PETRO-CHEMICAL CORP
(SINOPEC HEAD OFFICE).
PROCEEDS WILL BE USED FOR FINANCING/REFINANCING OF THE
PURCHASE OF MACHINERY AND EQUIPMENT FOR THE NEW
PETROCHEMICAL PLANT DEVELOPMENT IN MAOMING CITY
UNDERTAKEN BY SINOPEC MAOMING.
-- Hong Kong News Room (852) 2843 6960
